entities.name: A9W265 MinE
observations: Exact 95-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt A9W265 from Methylorubrum extorquens PA1; annotated as a cell-division topological specificity factor.
UniProt function: counteracts MinC/MinD inhibition at internal division sites while allowing polar inhibition, promoting septation at the cell midpoint.
Sequence-derived estimates: 10,578 Da; pI 9.77; GRAVY −0.087; instability index 27.28.
